collection.description: A villager who has always hated mangoes bites one and likes it, and someone saw: admit it, or deny everything.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For as long as anyone can remember, (subject) has loudly hated mangoes. Hated them. Wouldn't touch them. Today, without thinking, (subject.he/she) picks one up, bites into it, and realizes that (subject.he/she) actually likes it quite a lot. (friend) saw everything.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "That never happened," (subject) says, and puts the half-eaten mango down very calmly. (friend) raises an eyebrow. The next morning, though, the mango is gone, and (subject) has juice on (subject.his/her) chin.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "Fine," says (subject), mouth full. "They're good. Mangoes are good." (friend) is delighted. By evening the whole village knows, and three different people have brought (subject) a mango. (subject.He/She) eats all three.
